detail.readme: # UI SDK A library of behaviors for agents to build the next generation of user interfaces. Keyboard navigation, focus, selection, dismissal, popups, drag and drop and the ARIA they need live in `@ui-sdk/core`, with adapters for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid and Web Components. **[Read the docs](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs)** ## Install UI SDK is in beta. Install core and the adapter for your framework: ```bash npm install @ui-sdk/react @ui-sdk/core ``` For other frameworks, swap `@ui-sdk/react` for `@ui-sdk/vue`, `@ui-sdk/svelte`, `@ui-sdk/solid` or `@ui-sdk/web`. Then give your agent the UI SDK skill: ```bash npx skills add vercel-labs/ui --skill ui-sdk ``` ## Example Every component in UI SDK is built from behaviors. You start by creating the primitive with behaviors. Don't worry, you don't need to learn how to write this. Your agents will. And we made them really good at it. ```ts import { createFocusRecovery, definePrimitive } from "@ui-sdk/core" const searchField = definePrimitive({ name: "search-field", state: () => ({ value: "" }), api: (context) => ({ set: (value: string) => context.store.set({ value }), recovery: createFocusRecovery({ fallback: () => context.element("input") }), }), slots: (slot) => ({ input: slot({ attrs: (state) => ({ value: state.value }), on: { input: (event, { api }) => api.set((event.target as HTMLInputElement).value), }, }), clear: slot({ present: (state) => state.value !== "", attrs: () => ({ type: "button" }), press: ({ api }) => api.set(""), bind: (el, part) => part.api.recovery.bind(el, part), }), }), }) export { searchField } ``` Then render it in your framework with `createParts`. The parts are the same in all five. ### React ```tsx import { createParts } from "@ui-sdk/react/primitive" import { searchField } from "./search-field" const parts = createParts(searchField, { input: "input", clear: "button" }) const SearchField = parts.Root const SearchFieldInput = parts.Input const SearchFieldClear = parts.Clear function Search() { return ( Clear ) } export { Search } ``` ### Vue ```vue ``` ### Svelte ```svelte Clear ``` ### Solid ```tsx import { createParts } from "@ui-sdk/solid/primitive" import { searchField } from "./search-field" const parts = createParts(searchField, { input: "input", clear: "button" }) const SearchField = parts.Root const SearchFieldInput = parts.Input const SearchFieldClear = parts.Clear function Search() { return ( Clear ) } export { Search } ``` ### Web Components Register a custom element for each part: ```ts import { createParts, wrappedButton, wrappedChild } from "@ui-sdk/web" import { searchField } from "./search-field" createParts(searchField, { root: "search-field", input: { tag: "search-field-input", target: wrappedChild("input") }, clear: { tag: "search-field-clear", target: wrappedButton }, }) ``` Then use them in your HTML: ```html ``` ## Contributing Contributions are welcome. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) to get the repo running locally and land a change, and use [issues](https://github.com/vercel-labs/ui/issues) to report bugs. By participating, you agree to our [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). ## Security Please do not open public issues for security vulnerabilities. Instead, follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) and report responsibly to [responsible.disclosure@vercel.com](mailto:responsible.disclosure@vercel.com). ## Beta terms UI SDK is currently in beta and subject to the [Vercel beta terms](https://vercel.com/docs/release-phases/public-beta-agreement); the framework, APIs, documentation, and behavior may change before general availability.
